rows.note: Use this everyday default when someone or something causes another person severe mental or physical suffering.

example.english: That lawsuit caused him to agonize for years.
example.traditional: 呢場官司折磨咗佢幾年。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 gun1 si1 zit3 mo4 zo2 keoi5 gei2 nin4

rows.note: Use this everyday default when a person is undergoing severe physical or emotional suffering.

example.english: I agonize every day, unable to sleep at night because of the pain.
example.traditional: 我每日都受折磨，夜晚痛到瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 sau6 zit3 mo4 je6 maan5 tung3 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6
